district.title: Pick a district
district.text: Click any district to see its mood, problems and trends. You can rotate and zoom the map.

mood.title: Mark your mood
mood.text: How do you feel in your district today? One tap and your voice joins the district's overall colour. Nobody sees individual marks.
mood.textCompact: Tap “+” and choose “Mark your mood”: one tap and your voice joins the district's overall colour.

report.title: Report a problem
report.text: Rubbish, a pothole, a dark yard — put a point on the map and add a photo. Neighbours will confirm it, and you'll be notified when work starts.
report.textCompact: Also under “+”: “Report a problem” — a point on the map and a photo. You'll be notified when work starts.
